title: Unstable backrest
review_text: The chair is convenient to carry, but the backrest wobbles when I lean backward.

title: Lightweight design
review_text: I like how lightweight and compact the seat is, although the cushion could be thicker.

title: Easy to transport
review_text: The backpack storage makes this chair easy to carry to outdoor events.

title: Difficult adjustment
review_text: The reclining mechanism takes some effort to adjust and does not always feel secure.

title: Useful but expensive
review_text: The chair folds neatly and is practical for the beach, but the price seems high.

title: Comfortable on flat ground
review_text: The seat works well on level surfaces, but I would prefer better grip on uneven ground.
